svg.aria-label: CR2032 coin cell layer diagram, from bottom to top: positive case, SS spacer (bottom electrode), electrolyte film or wetted separator (thickness L), SS spacer (top electrode), spring, gasket, negative cap. Area A is calculated from the spacer diameter d.
